description: Product claims of Identity's /userinfo besides sub (Learning reads them from the answer that authorizes a request; it reads no Identity table). Booleans, computed on every request. mnema_public_profile is listed in contracts/decks/publication.json. The two claims below are internal anti-abuse signals of the community ranking: they are never shown to anybody and carry no personal data.

trusted.rule: the account's e-mail is verified (local accounts: email_verified; federated accounts: the provider vouched for the e-mail) AND the account was created at least minAgeHours ago
trusted.learningUse: a copy by an account that is not trusted weighs 0.25 in the rank; an absent or malformed claim is false

newAccount.rule: the account was created less than maxAgeHours ago
newAccount.learningUse: a copy by a new account counts toward the anomaly flag of the owner console (catalog.json constants.anomaly); an absent or malformed claim is false and never raises a flag
